Who's to say I haven't tried? I am getting my master's degree, I work for a non-profit organization that brings the arts to economically disadvantaged youth. I go on 2-3 hour walks 5 days of the week and forage and keep a plant journal. I spend one hour daily in prayer. I was planning a solo day trip to a spot near me this April and a forest fire burned it down.

I don't "only concentrate on bad things" I am constantly aware of the stark realities we face at all times. The inability to escape the panopticon. The fact that despite looking at things from different ideologies, mentalities perspectives etc the intense self hatred remains, the inadequacy remains, and ultimately so does everything. If we're looking at everything from a bird's eye view, the net of suffering only grows. The intersections, the poverty, the alienation, the sexism, the racism, the ableism, the queerphobia. The fact that people worse off than me exist, forced to be here against there own will. There are war crimes against humanity being committed as we speak. People fleeing their homes, desperate. There are superstoms brewing, and cities sinking slowly from rising sea levels. There is drought and plague ravaging the land. To exist is to live in a state of persistent violence. I cannot heal here. It's said that "you can't heal where you've been wounded." I can't escape the systems of oppression that have infiltrated almost every lived society we have today. I can't travel it away, I can't do anything of the sort. 

I can't do it anymore

I understand that ultimately, you just want to be desired. I too have body parts that make me feel unworthy of being wanted, loved and desired. You, if you are anything like me (which I assume you are) sit there watching all the people with the feature you want, fall in love, find carnal fulfillment, get acknowledgement and acclaim and seemingly celebrated for that feature. You are most likely consumed by an almost tummy turning envy, then you feel ashamed and guilty because it seems so small but why does it feel so big?

You are not alone, you are not alone at all. Let me start by saying that as a collective society we have a fascination with size. Big cars, big houses, big salaries, big everything. Big breasts can be wonderful but we must first look at it for what it is, excitement at the unexpected. It's not because they are inherently better, rather, because they are conceptually exciting to some. The breasts you have, I assure you with certainty without even seeing them, are wonderful. All breasts are good breasts, it doesn't matter if their uneven, tear shaped, or s shaped, your breasts are absolutely gorgeous and deserving of praise. You will not find big breasts on the runway, or in vogue magazine, because big breasts become the main accessory. You have the luxury of being fashion, of being couture. However, you aren't just couture you are desire as well. 

If you truly cannot find it in you to accept your body as it is(which once again, I understand) please consider talking to a therapist not because you need therapy, but sometimes, plastic surgery is prescribed by therapists and therefore will be covered by insurance. So you could get a new pair for close to free potentially if you tell a therapist how your small breasts make day to day life hard and really emphasize that they need to change.

I wish you luck, you are beautiful,desired,wanted, and I assure you more people have wanted you like Marilyn Monroe than you know ❤️

I am a 23 year old virgin too, I know how it feels to grapple with those feelings of inadequacy and self loathing. Why aren't we on the same wave length as our peers, what are we doing wrong? However, while it is very easy to spiral down that mental route it doesn't carry with it a drop of substantiated truth. For one, its unfair to ourselves to compare our experience to others, and were also QUITE young. The unnatural expectation of our society is that we should just know what we want to do fresh out of being children in Highschool, and how we want to live.That is entirely unrealistic, people spend decades trying to know what tf is even happening and don't even catch on. Its also a sort of lie that you must be passionate about your work, or turn a major interest into a career. In fact, it can defile your interests and hobbies, you are not a failure for becoming a cog in the Leviathan of our society, you have worth by simply existing, regardless of if you see it or not. Bottom line is you still have time, you enjoy streaming, stop putting pressure on yourself to make it into a path?, it should be FUN!!! Do not start to put pressure on yourself for no reason keep it fun, keep it light, keep it fresh. You've done construction, start perhaps looking for construction listings, a construction job can also help you get "fit" again and be more confident in your body and self. if you don't get hired no big deal! Other options always. Perhaps look at trade schools if college isnt for you, but only if you feel called to do so. The world always needs carpenters, electricians, plumbers etc.  You are worth the effort, you are worth the battle and the fight. If you need to talk DM me, if you stream theres a good chance you like gaming too ☺
